_comment: Hand edits applied on top of the OpenStreetMap draft of Uppsala C (scripts/stations/draft_from_osm.py). Two floors: street, station hall and platforms (OSM level 0) and Centralpassagen, the passage under the tracks (-1). Platform 1 is beside the station house; one long island has tracks 2/3 and 4/7 south of the passage (3 and 4 are bay tracks) and 5/6 north of it; the 8 island is on the east side. Checked against UL's Resecentrum i Uppsala map (winter 2026) supplied by the owner: track numbers, the three lifts (station house, island north of the passage, 8 island), the stairs from the passage up to the island and up to the east side all match OSM. Not modelled: the plan's up escalator beside the island stairs (edges have no direction, and the stairs next to it are in the graph) and OSM's platforms 9 and 10, which are the museum railway Lennakatten's narrow-gauge platforms (not on the plan's track list).

connections.note: OSM gap: the island lift north of the passage (node 12626518111, level 0;-1; HISS on UL's map) has no way on the passage side, so the draft can't join its two floors.
OSM gap: the station-house lift (node 12626024022, level 0;-1) opens into the passage at a door node that isn't joined to the passage footway (OSM has two separate door nodes at the same spot).

sources.title: UL, Resecentrum i Uppsala (winter 2026 map, PDF of 2025-11-07)
sources.note: Supplied by the owner; used to check track numbers, lifts, stairs, the passage and ticket machines, not copied. Not ODbL; see data/stations/README.md.
Jernhusen's list of shops and cafés with opening hours (Subway's and DOZ Apotek's hours taken from it; it is newer than OSM's). Its toilet page says the toilets are on the upper floor, card payment.
Laserdata Nedladdning, skog, © Lantmäteriet, bearbetad, CC BY 4.0: building and roof heights and the ground (3D research pass; pack in data/stations/research/740000005).
JNB 2027 Bilaga 2A and BanInfo Plattform: platform height classes (3D research pass; data/stations/research/trafikverket_platforms_SE.csv).

changelog.what: First draft from OSM (2026-10-19 extract), checked against UL's Resecentrum i Uppsala map (winter 2026): the island lift and the station-house lift's passage door joined by hand, Lennakatten's platforms 9 and 10 and a bookshop in its station left out, two ticket machines in the passage added from OSM, Subway's and DOZ Apotek's hours from Jernhusen (2026-10-22).
Platform heights from Trafikverket's register; 24 buildings, roofs and footbridges with laser heights; the ground as a 5 m grid (3D research pass, data/stations/research/740000005).
